title: Unique normalized exchange at a single rational coefficient stage
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a compact-support square of noetherian finite-dimensional schemes $X',X,Y',Y$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$, and compactifications $c=(j,p),c'=(j',p')$ with a specified proper Cartesian square and open Cartesian square [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. Supply normalized families $H,H',P,P'$ [def-cbc-normalized-coefficient-families] for these four operations. For each finite coefficient stage $E$ there is exactly one natural transformation $\tau_E:H_E \mathbin{\cdot} P_{g,E}\Rightarrow P_{g',E} \mathbin{\cdot} H'_E$ (composition in Lean functor order) whose component on every localized integral object $K$ is the localization of the actual completedCompactSupportExchange [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map]. This component equation holds for every finite generating tuple of the coefficient ideal and every intrinsic-completeness witness; its two endpoints belong to the integral constructible complete category. There is no coefficient-stage compatibility assertion.

proof.text: The unit-normalized completed open exchange is independent of the generating tuple: restrict the comparison from one complete full domain to another and invoke uniqueness of the same ordinary/unit equation. Consequently its composite with the proper exchange is independent too. The existing private finiteExtension_exchange_generators gives this exact equality.

proof.text: The canonical tensor localization is equivalent to the existing Rationalization category by the tensor-Hom equivalence. It is therefore a localization functor; precomposition with it is full. Extend the integral natural map (after target localization) through this full whiskering functor, conjugating by the four functor equalities. Its component equation is the conjugation HEq lemma; generator independence gives the formula for every tuple. Every rational object is an integral object, so the formula determines all components and NatTrans.ext gives uniqueness.

lean.statement:
theorem cbcRationalExchangeStage_existsUnique
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (H : CbcCompactSupportCoefficientFamily l Ω c)
    (H' : CbcCompactSupportCoefficientFamily l Ω c')
    (P : CbcCompletedPullCoefficientFamily l Ω g)
    (P' : CbcCompletedPullCoefficientFamily l Ω g')
    (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) :
    ∃! τ : (H.family.base.Φ E ⋙ P.family.base.Φ E) ⟶
        (P'.family.base.Φ E ⋙ H'.family.base.Φ E),
      ∀ (K : pbcIntegralStage l Ω X E)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → PbcIntegralRing l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E))
    (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E).ideal)
    (hc : cbcCompleteProperty (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E) X r a ha K.obj),
    ∃ (hs : PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y' (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
        ((cbcDerivedOpenShriek (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E) c.i c.isOpenImmersion ⋙
          (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E).push c.g ⋙
            (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E).completedPull g).obj K.obj))
      (ht : PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y' (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
        (((pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E).completedPull g' ⋙
          cbcDerivedOpenShriek (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E) c'.i c'.isOpenImmersion ⋙
            (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E).push c'.g).obj K.obj)),
      HEq (τ.app ((pbcStageLocalization l Ω X E).obj K))
        ((pbcStageLocalization l Ω Y' E).map
          (ObjectProperty.homMk (X := ⟨_, hs⟩) (Y := ⟨_, ht⟩)
            (completedCompactSupportExchange (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
              c c' gbar properSquare openSquare r a ha ⟨K.obj, hc⟩)))

tool_uses.why: Generic Functorial transport to a finite field is used only through its stated ambient ringed-site, coefficient, derived-category or localization interface; the compact-support unit supplies no replacement for this tool. The unit route through j_!, proper direct image and the specified exchange is retained.

The generic tensor localization comparison with Rationalization gives fullness of precomposition with integral localization. It constructs only the natural transformation on the fixed raw category, without altering the compact-support or coefficient-coherence route.
